subject.title: fix(review-placeholder): rank recovery discovery before the check budget

question: Should the reconciliation workflow intentionally fail on the currently known placeholder backlog when `remaining` exceeds the new default threshold of 480?
rationale: This is an operational policy choice: the supplied proof shows a default run would report thousands of remaining matches and fail, but only maintainers can decide whether that alerting behavior is appropriate for the production schedule and incident workflow.

options.title: Confirm the alert policy after a live dry run
options.body: Run one redacted live recovery or scheduled dry run, confirm the current backlog and notification behavior, then retain the default threshold of 480.

options.title: Use a higher initial threshold
options.body: Keep the recovery fixes but raise the default or repository variable until the legacy backlog is reduced, avoiding continuous scheduled failures.

options.title: Separate alerting from workflow failure
options.body: Retain the new summary metrics while routing backlog notification through a non-failing health signal if scheduled-job failure is too disruptive.

recommendation.title: Confirm the alert policy after a live dry run
recommendation.body: Run one redacted live recovery or scheduled dry run, confirm the current backlog and notification behavior, then retain the default threshold of 480.
